The oracle is the PUBLISHED package hl7.fhir.uv.ips#2.0.1 (fhir-spec/hl7.fhir.uv.ips.tgz): the IG
Publisher's output for exactly these sources, i.e. what SUSHI produced, plus publisher-added content
(snapshots, narrative, dates, publisher metadata) that the comparison ignores. See
tests/ig-fsh-test.rkt for what is compared.
